fusions.name: Snag Line
fusions.desc: A weapon strike trailing a barbed line that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Gaff Winch
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Fires a winched gaff at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, which deals 24 damage.

fusions.name: Haul-In Lines
fusions.desc: Fires barbed lines that reel up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and hold their attention for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Pawl
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 10% more damage.
